notes.title: 宗门密报|最强祖师x大话西游联动开启！
notes.content:
各位祖师好呀！
《最强祖师》×《大话西游》联动5月20日正式开启。
在第1阶段活动中，除了有至尊宝等3位联动弟子登场外，还有不少活动挑战和福利等着大家。
快来一起看看第1阶段【月光宝盒】的活动情报吧~


[b]活动1-月光宝盒
活动时间[/b]
5月20日0点可开启，持续14天。
※活动开启时可能会有几分钟延时，请祖师留意。

[b]开启条件[/b]
开服时间达到30天及以上的区服
※若开服时间未达到30天，则在达到30天的时候开启活动；
※《大话西游》联动主题服开服第8日即可参与活动。

[b]活动内容
1. 签到赠礼[/b]
活动期间，祖师可以参与连续14天的联动签到。
完成登录签到即可获得联动弟子至尊宝，以及限定头像框、寻仙令*35等奖励。
※如果祖师已获得过弟子至尊宝，签到获得的至尊宝将自动转化为至尊宝灵魄*50。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/46a734ecb40d6d44e7fa6c6a4abcdefa2764328e.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果

[b]2. 真心话[/b]
活动期间除最后1日外，祖师每天都可参与一次真心话问答，获得灵玉等答题奖励。
除了答题奖励，根据所选的回答，祖师每天还可获得一定的答题积分。当总积分达到150分及以上时可参与积分排行，获得混沌天命灵魄等奖励。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/428fa72bbb2f8ab6087154d5c664a322be1e67a7.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/428fa72bbb2f8ab6087154d5c664a322be1e67a7.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/1312863c400cd6440c26ad58a83e05a441852b3b.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果

[b]3. 放映厅[/b]
在放映厅内，祖师可通过推进剧幕的方式了解至尊宝等弟子的故事。
在推进剧幕的过程中，祖师需要完成答题、小游戏、秘境探险、BOSS战斗等挑战。
放映厅活动共有21幕剧幕，每推进一幕都可获得寻仙令等剧幕奖励。部分剧幕通关后还可解锁挑战模式，完成挑战还可获得灵玉等额外奖励。
完成全部剧幕后，即可获得联动限定古宝月光宝盒。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/74bd32de8069811279038c23fcc6ffe481cfbb0b.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/e5e942de792e521f53695e83f2a788f00408a242.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/9f3d4a5643c2c87715e088e2f3a4e5fc064ca2b5.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果

[b]4. 绘影拼图[/b]
活动期间，祖师可接取拼图任务，完成后可获得奖励。
累计完成一定数量的任务或是完成整张拼图还可获得建筑图纸-水帘洞、寻仙令等奖励。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/227bedbbf04e0ceb71cb8c59a5b87266921d213a.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/227bedbbf04e0ceb71cb8c59a5b87266921d213a.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果

[b]5. 万宗对决[/b]
活动期间将陆续开启宗门生产、丹药炼制等阶段比拼，祖师完成阶段主题相关的操作即可获得积分。
在每个比拼阶段，祖师获得的积分达到一定数量后，即可解锁无字天书、星尘石英等目标奖励。
另外，活动还设有阶段积分排行和总榜积分排行，成功上榜的祖师将有机会获得混沌天命灵魄、无字天书等排名奖励。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/dea7025aba92928a32e1e9646d152a14fd081cbd.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/8551fb4cff4745ae3351dc38a26ddabb4aaa02ec.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果

[b]6. 累计充值[/b]
活动期间，祖师累计充值达到一定数量，还可领取特质自选盒、真灵精血、至宝仙匣等珍稀道具，感兴趣的祖师届时可以了解下哦~
※不同区服累充活动可解锁的道具有一定的差异，还请各位祖师注意，以游戏内的活动奖励为准。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/2a7e90c05ccd2f2999242852c0d698632a618002.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/14060d8fad8390f4ecb5154b6af09fafe5641d1c.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果



[b]活动2-月光奇缘[/b]
[b]活动时间[/b]
5月20日0点可开启，持续14天。
※活动开启时可能会有几分钟延时，请祖师留意。

[b]开启条件[/b]
开服时间达到30天及以上的区服
※若开服时间未达到30天，则在达到30天的时候开启活动；
※《大话西游》联动主题服开服第8日即可参与活动。

[b]活动内容
1. 月盒寻仙[/b]
活动期间，消耗道具【寻仙令】可以抽取《大话西游》联动专属弟子。
祖师可以自行从弟子至尊宝、紫霞、白晶晶，以及胡十三娘、敖天、苜蓿、石僧、卫寒等弟子中选择3人作为可抽取的弟子，并且可以在选定的3名弟子中，选择其中1名弟子作为心愿弟子。
※不同区服可选弟子有所差别，还请祖师以游戏内活动为准。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/4fa5c7be619baf76175a783e64b2356db7348539.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/d21d94ecafe2a0fbcc41f4bbd1255843206365f9.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果

其中禅修-至尊宝、剑修-紫霞、密修-白晶晶是本次新上线的联动弟子。
将联动弟子的天命提升至指定等级，不仅可以免费领取寻仙令、灵玉等奖励，还可以购买直购礼包，获取全新功法渡厄真经、心缘剑诀、九幽镇狱掌。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/1a8e61a34d09507d66bcad290b542f9bdbddc96d.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/b56bf6ec7b2600f2c92997b65e9604bb1f997750.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果


当至尊宝、紫霞、白晶晶达到天阶天命时，祖师可分别通过直购礼包购买以下功法。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/702061a6e331f000b674e3e5199da03547f4de83.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/cca5fa96ecf86109f062a1b8c9370e4d07ecaf0c.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/c64172c4548902da56b19f40c0cac68be22af9ab.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果

※祖师只要解锁联动弟子即可随时参与该弟子的天命赠礼活动，不受联动活动时间影响。

当然，祖师通过【且试身手】活动观看新弟子战斗演示也可免费领取寻仙令等奖励。
关于至尊宝等联动弟子的详细信息小清瑶已经发布在【仙缘图鉴】栏目，感兴趣的祖师可以前往查看哦~

[b]2. 弟子助力[/b]
新弟子初次登门拜师，修行进度难免落后于其他弟子。
本次活动期间，【弟子助力】活动也会限时开启，祖师可通过购买礼包的方式获取天道之气、荒古兽血、异化仙藤等材料，助力弟子快速提升实力，感兴趣的祖师可不要错过了~
※不同区服弟子助力活动可购买道具有一定的差异，还请各位祖师注意，以游戏内的活动奖励为准。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/e59d22b3a7c4ff4983c5b6f271c1bdf79184692b.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果


[b]3. 奇缘商店[/b]
活动期间，祖师每消耗1枚寻仙令即可获得10仙缘币。
前往奇缘商店可通过消耗仙缘币兑换联动建筑形象-花烛洞房等道具。
除消耗寻仙令外，祖师也可以购买限时礼包和灵玉礼包来获取仙缘值。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/d9e15e0d6bbb653624042a15c64663d607389fec.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/1e1eea1b069379110f239f72f5704a6e40fcb6b7.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/7e9599b25e69a392ab0180b8defa28b0ba3352ac.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果

※仙缘币会在仙界奇缘活动结束时清空，各位祖师要记得及时兑换。

[b]活动3-重走西游[/b]
[b]活动时间[/b]
5月20日0点-8月10日24点
※活动开启时可能会有几分钟延时，请祖师留意。
[b]开启范围[/b]
1.在2025年5月20日之前开启的全部区服；
2.《大话西游》联动主题服。

[b]活动内容[/b]
活动期间，祖师需要从玩法中招募弟子进行历练探索，探索过程中会遇到各种事件，完成事件可获得法则/装备等玩法道具，祖师可以合理选择搭配提升试炼队伍实力，以推进探索进度。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/e8db5945f11364812bedb74e40d27e15a2de91d1.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/63ac639f91984c48e29d472f6725ef999b346e77.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/5ab86138ffe8a4a786a28ae20bd5dc6eb85257de.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果


每次历练结束后将会根据试炼进度结算活跃积分和段位积分。累计活跃积分可解锁试炼密卷奖励，累计段位积分则可获取寻仙令等段位奖励和取经宝匣等段位积分排行奖励。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/5fa2c03545e0a36aa4c9c66bac34b9df1660df7b.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/1e0392792b17fab317f44ccf2187ef8135f2f0c9.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/80ed2c2d6ef84e418dda5ae6d3f8aa6d326580df.jpg[/img]
测试环境下截图，非最终效果


好啦，以上就是联动第1阶段【月光宝盒】活动的简单介绍。

tags.feature: In the first stage of the event, in addition to the debut of three linked disciples such as Supreme Treasure, there are also many event challenges and welfare benefits waiting for everyone.

During the event, Ancestors can participate in a 14-day continuous linked sign-in. Completing the login sign-in will grant the linked disciple Supreme Treasure, as well as a limited avatar frame, 35 Immortal Seeking Orders, and other rewards.
During the event, Ancestors can participate in a truth or dare question once a day, except for the last day, to obtain quiz rewards such as Spirit Jade.

In the screening hall, Ancestors can understand the stories of disciples such as Supreme Treasure by advancing the plot. During the process of advancing the plot, Ancestors need to complete challenges such as answering questions, mini-games, secret realm exploration, and BOSS battles.
During the event, Ancestors can accept jigsaw puzzles and receive rewards after completion.
During the event, stages such as sect production and pill refining will be gradually opened for competition. Ancestors who complete operations related to the stage theme will receive points.
During the event, Ancestors can receive rare items such as Special Trait Selection Box, True Spirit Essence Blood, and Supreme Immortal Casket by accumulating a certain amount of recharge.
During the event, consume the item [Immortal Seeking Order] to draw linked disciples exclusive to "A Chinese Odyssey".
Among them, Zen cultivator - Supreme Treasure, Sword cultivator - Zixia, and Secret cultivator - Bai Jingjing are the new linked disciples launched this time.
When Supreme Treasure, Zixia, and Bai Jingjing reach the Heavenly Mandate level, Ancestors can purchase the following cultivation methods through direct purchase gift packs.
Ancestors can also receive Immortal Seeking Orders and other rewards for free by watching the new disciples' combat demonstrations through the [Trying Your Hand] event.

During the event, the [Disciple Assistance] event will also be opened for a limited time. Ancestors can obtain materials such as Heavenly Dao Qi, Desolate Beast Blood, and Mutated Immortal Vine by purchasing gift packs to help disciples quickly improve their strength.

During the event, for every 1 Immortal Seeking Order consumed, Ancestors will receive 10 Fate Coins. Go to the Fate Shop to exchange for items such as the linked building image - Candle Cave Dwelling by consuming Fate Coins.

During the event, Ancestors need to recruit disciples from the gameplay for training and exploration. Various events will be encountered during the exploration. Completing events can obtain gameplay items such as Laws/Equipment. Ancestors can reasonably choose and match to improve the strength of the trial team and advance the exploration progress.

After each training, active points and rank points will be settled based on the trial progress. Accumulating active points can unlock trial scroll rewards, and accumulating rank points can obtain rank rewards such as Immortal Seeking Orders and trial box rewards such as Journey to the West Treasure Box.

notes.title: A Wonderful Encounter, a Joyful Vacation!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/4b53706dfdf4de39424d110a421d8111c885c460.jpg[/img]

[b] Qiankun Lingchi

[/b]

[b] Activity time [/b]

From September 20 to September 26, the patriarch who has been open for 29 days can participate in the Qiankun Spirit Pool theme activities, including Qiankun Spirit Pool, Tianshu practice, and Tongbao Fairy Market.

PS: If the master's district service does not meet the activation conditions on September 20, this activity will also be started if the conditions are met later, and the activity will continue for 7 days. The master can go to [Event Calendar] to check the number of days the area service is open.

[b] Activity content

Spiritual Practice [/b]

During the activity, the master can obtain basic rewards such as Lingyu and ancient treasure Shengxing Stone by completing the task of Tianshu. Completing the specified number of Tianshu tasks can also receive additional Qiankun coins, Lingyu, Tianyunna Lingdan and other stage standard rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/a9907261623380bc7b9e37d2ee4ab3bb671ada91.jpg[/img]



[b] Tongbao Xian City [/b]

During the activity, Tongbao Xian City is open for a limited time, providing Qiankun coins, wishing coins, Stardust quartz and other precious props for the master to exchange. According to their own situation, the master can choose to consume spiritual stone, magic weapon refining materials and other props to exchange.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/0813a97658fd28fa3f148ace4a5fc9beee5a4aaf.jpg[/img]





[b] [/b]

[b] Activity time [/b]

September 27 - October 10

[b] Activity content [/b]

1. Sign in gifts

During the activity, the master can log in to the game every day to participate in the signing for free to receive the signing gift, and the cumulative signing can get the fairy search order *50 and other benefits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/6e8dfb656d20293ab9fe59ba60df73be9e74414f.jpg[/img]

2. Wonderland

During the activity, the consumption of props "Fairy search" can be selected exclusive disciples. The patriarch could choose one of the six disciples - Clover, Shi Seng, Qin Bing, Tang Dieyi, Xiao Chen and Sanqi - as his desired disciple.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/af7b40de0a5209b51647843a6fd3a0957fbf270a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/3c9faf50bdc212518549aaabc08c91d8b4feb0f6.png[/img]

Its traditional Chinese medicine practice [alfalfa] and meditation [Stone monk] are the exclusive disciples of this new on-line.

If the dedicated disciple's destiny is upgraded to the designated level, he can not only receive free rewards such as seeking fairy orders and spirit jade, but also buy direct purchase packages to obtain the disciple's exclusive Tao soldiers and exercises.

[i]PS: As long as the master unlocks the disciple, he can participate in the gift of the disciple's destiny at any time, regardless of the time of the "Celestial Wonderland" activity.

[/i]

3. The Demon Test

During the activity, the master can challenge 6 leader monsters one after another, and completing the challenge of different monsters can obtain clearance rewards such as seeking fairy order, Stardust quartz or damage rating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/c9a7958513f042feda63cbc4c6f9b6c9fd94d76f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/f5fbb065a7caebf4293bc14f9b85fbc0f10f6bf9.png[/img]



4. Reach the mark

During the activity, the master will draw the number of times in the "Fairy Wonderland" activity to meet the target requirements, you can receive free hand-down Kung Fu box, hand-down Tao warrior box and other standard rewards, and will also unlock the purchase rights of different gear special gift packages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/e813acd7ffd5501504b2b48e4ce04f8c6685b258.jpg[/img]



5. Adventure Store

During the activity, the master can earn 10 fairy edge value for every 1 fairy search order consumed. Go to the magic store to redeem items such as Red Recruitment Order, Chaos Destiny Spirit, and No character Book by consuming fairy value and specific resources.

In addition to consuming the fairy search order, the master can also purchase the limited-time gift pack and the Spirit Jade gift pack to obtain the fairy edge value.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/d90d24eae2599c8f527cd600a8470ed634713f0c.jpg[/img]



[b] Fairy Festival [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/0ea65290796a27d038575fd5b79623153d31d3e4.jpg[/img]

[b] Activity time [/b]

October 1st - October 7th



Activity content

1. Holiday sign-in

During the activity, you can log in to the game every day to get a good signing gift, accumulated can get Fu card *210, Cloud City Baoci *20, landscape architecture - Tai Shang Fu building and other rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/af1e8b3be5e2cf6e9de3db733669205431dce523.png[/img]

2. The auspicious beast is at the door

During the activity, the Zongmen will have auspicious beasts every day, and consume the props such as "Pixiu treasure money" or magic weapons, Dan medicine and so on to feed them can get fairy order, spirit jade and other rewards, and activate the blessing effect: Zongmen production output +20%, lasting 12 hours

PS: 【 Pixiu treasure money 】 can be obtained by completing the task of spiritual cultivation ~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/56fa5e62666679951210a17a96e7c1d4b72f25d0.png[/img]

3. Spiritual practice

During the activity period, completing the corresponding tasks on the activity page can obtain the task rewards such as Blessing card and Lingyu;

Cumulative completion of the specified number of tasks can be awarded Cloud City Baobo *20, Pixiu Baoqian *3 and other standard awards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/6f4fe215def6ea15d05264e3b57e7ceefa6fbef8.jpg[/img]

4. Treasure hunt in Cloud City

Cloud City treasure hunt is a dice running game, the master needs to throw [Cloud city treasure dice] on the map treasure hunt.

Various chest rewards and adventure events are triggered during this period. Each time you complete a circle, the Master will enter the next circle, and treasure chests and events on the map will be refreshed randomly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44997876/152b14864fd70d0d1a79d713c4a3ce26f7aadc41.jpg[/img]
